content.text:
Now I understand the full picture. The DTO-level `@Pattern("^[0-9]*$")` (generated from openapi.yml) rejects `(04) 1234-5678` at the `@Valid` gate before any controller code runs, and only `MethodArgumentNotValidException` maps to 400. My plan (2 files):

1. Relax the openapi telephone pattern so it accepts separators but still enforces **exactly 10 digits after stripping** — `^\D*(\d\D*){10}$`. This reuses the existing bean-validation→400 path for the reject case (`12345` → 5 digits → 400) with zero new validation code.
2. Normalize (strip non-digits) in `Owner.setTelephone`, so the stored/returned value is the 10-digit form.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'

## Summary

The change makes `POST /api/owners` normalize the telephone by stripping every non-digit character, require exactly 10 digits, and store/return the 10-digit value — rejecting anything else with 400.

Two files touched, each with a minimal, cohesive change:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — relaxed the telephone `pattern` from `^[0-9]*$` to `^\D*(\d\D*){10}$`. This is the key insight: the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` carries this pattern as a `@Pattern` constraint, and `@Valid` runs it *before* any controller code, with only `MethodArgumentNotValidException` mapping to 400 in `ExceptionControllerAdvice`. The old pattern rejected `(04) 1234-5678` outright; the new one accepts any string that contains *exactly ten* digits interspersed with non-digits, and rejects `12345` (only 5 digits) with 400 — reusing the existing validation→400 path with **zero new validation code**.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — `setTelephone` now strips non-digits (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`) so the persisted/returned value is the clean 10-digit form (`0412345678`). CC stays trivial (one null-guard), and the entity uses field access for JPA hydration, so this only affects programmatic sets (the create mapping), not DB reads.

Structural impact was kept low: no changes to the controller or the large service classes, no new validators or classes. The 400-rejection behavior is delegated entirely to the existing bean-validation pipeline via the regex, and the only Java function edited is a one-line setter on the model.

Test result: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — BUILD SUCCESS (`coreStripsToTenDigits` and `errorRejectsTooFewDigits` both green).
